Name: No Fly Sound
Author: KimmJoja
Description:
Replaces or removes the buzzing sound of flying monsters using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
You can select the alternative sound in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu(GMCM)[/url]. To preview each sound, check the sound files in the mod folder/assets.


[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]를 사용하여 벌레 몬스터의 윙윙거리는 소리를 대체하거나 삭제합니다.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu(GMCM)[/url] 메뉴에서 대체 사운드를 선택할 수 있습니다. 각 사운드는 모드 폴더/assets 내에서 들어볼 수 있습니다.


使用[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]替换或移除飞行怪物发出的嗡嗡声。
您可在[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu(GMCM)[/url]中选择替代音效。预览各音效时，请检查mod文件夹/assets目录中的音频文件
